scope: Read-only source and retained repository evidence review. This is a release-admission decision for the intended current-weight PTQ1/adapter profile, not a compiled promotion score, a new producer authentication, or an intrinsic PTQ1 format verdict. PLAN.md remains the sole backlog.

retainedPositiveEvidence.directionConsistency: The independently reviewed historical hosted result compares all 129 B factors / 660480 channels to the selected public direction with zero numeric difference. It establishes B-direction consistency, not checkpoint provenance, independent A reconstruction, native writer mapping or current-runtime behavior.
retainedPositiveEvidence.referencePreparation: The declared public producer, separate standard-library retained-data auditor and six historical small replay controls exist. Source preparation and fixture success are not a result from the complete public pack.

blockingConditions.observation: The reviewed docs/evidence inventory contains no report of kind independent-public-pack-A-reference and no ssm-*.f32le result files. The retained 0.1.14 readiness audit likewise reports no complete all-48 payload result. No numerical mismatch from the actual full reconstruction is asserted.
blockingConditions.requiredEvidence: The one declared hosted recipe public-mlx-f16-inverse1024-f16-f32-dot-v1, all 48 A-vector files, complete fixed-bound metrics, separately authenticated producer identities and independent scalar replay/review. The existing 1e-5 + 1e-5 * abs(reference) bound is unchanged.

blockingConditions.observation: The retained public-input audit identifies no original unfolded-checkpoint identities or approved-adapter-bound conversion invocation/toolchain record. That historical public observation is not a claim about today's network state or all possible private inputs. No new public-source query was made.
blockingConditions.requiredEvidence: Authenticate the original checkpoint/index/shard identities, exact exporter and invocation/preprocessing, direction/normalization, toolchain/matrix implementation, and output binding to the selected adapter. A public reconstruction match cannot authenticate which original inputs or invocation the author used.

blockingConditions.condition: Independent all-site native writer basis and application
blockingConditions.observation: No independently qualified all-48 authoring-to-native signed mapping and writer-input/residual-correction record is established. Historical matching logits against the same native implementation, loading, output text or zero-scale streams do not establish that basis.
blockingConditions.requiredEvidence: Independently verify the declared 6144-channel signed permutation at all 48 SSM sites and native writer inputs/corrections; retain released-runtime no-adapter/loaded-zero logits/state identity and nonzero application. The scalar/explicit-NEON and broader promotion gates remain separate.

intakeCannotSupplyMissingAuthentication.reviewedBehavior: Requires current locked runtime/model/adapter identities, a complete signed permutation, exact all-48 inventory, bounded manifests and raw-byte hashes. It compares declared A vectors but always leaves authoringProvenanceQualified, aFactorReproductionQualified, writerBasisQualified and defaultMayChange false. The provenance validator checks declared index/conversion/toolchain consistency without reading checkpoint shard payloads or authenticating the original declarations.

admissionRationale: The intended standard-adapter profile cannot satisfy its existing basis/provenance contract using the retained evidence. These missing independent inputs and validations are sufficient for a definite current release no-go even if local implementation checks pass. Dropping the adapter, widening tolerances, trusting self-declared manifests or transferring the older 0.1.13 numerical pass would change the candidate or weaken qualification rather than close this blocker.
reconsiderationBoundary: Reconsider this adapter admission decision only after the existing PLAN critical-path evidence is retained and independently reviewed against settled source/runtime/model/adapter identities. A future public all-48 match closes only its declared numerical reconstruction scope; provenance, native mapping, application and the remaining release gates still require their own evidence.
reviewMethod: Read retained documents and source, search the scoped repository evidence inventory, and hash the listed small files. Absence findings apply only to the reviewed repository snapshot; they do not prove that no external or private evidence exists. This review did not execute a diagnostic or qualification workload.
